parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.description_en: The name of the data source. It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese or Japanese character occupies 2 characters.
parameters.description_zh: 数据源名称，支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度为1~30个字符，一个中文及日文占2个字符。
